changes.before: Expired unless extension adopted [VERIFY: no extension resolution or replacement ordinance located on Troup County website as of 2026-04-29]

The 90-day moratorium (adopted 2025-09-16) was extended twice: 90 days on 2025-12-02 (to 2026-03-16), and a further 90 days on 2026-02-17 (to 2026-06-14), per the county's official public notice. Troup County's own agenda system shows a final zoning text amendment on 'Data Centers and Cryptocurrency or Data Mining Facilities' reached '3rd Reading - Vote Eligible' status at the May 5, 2026 Board meeting, with ordinance text providing to repeal conflicting prior ordinances and resolutions; secondary news coverage (LaGrange Daily News, via a forum repost) describes a unanimous vote around May 8, 2026 adopting the final ordinance and lifting the moratorium. The May 5, 2026 meeting minutes were not yet posted to independently confirm the exact vote date/tally, so some residual uncertainty remains on the precise adoption date.

changes.before: Moratorium proposal withdrawn. Lansing ZBA later treated the proposed high-performance-computing data center as a permitted use under existing industrial/research zoning; local groups filed an Article 78 challenge.
changes.after: Moratorium proposal withdrawn November 19, 2025. The Lansing Zoning Board of Appeals ruled on December 23, 2025 that the proposed AI/HPC data center is a permitted "general processing" use under existing industrial/research zoning; Cayuga Lake Action Now (CLEAN) and FLX Strong filed an Article 78 petition in NY State Supreme Court on January 30, 2026 against the Lansing ZBA and TeraWulf challenging that ruling. The outcome of the Article 78 petition was not confirmed as of this pass (2026-07-31); the last located update was an April 14, 2026 report on a separate state water-permit approval for the associated power plant, which could not be accessed this pass due to source rate-limiting.
changes.reason: Ithaca Voice's coverage (individually fetched articles dated 2025-12-23 and 2026-01-30) confirms the sequence of events after the withdrawal.
